free_text_notes.physician_note: 59-year-old woman with type 2 diabetes, alcohol use disorder in remission, admitted 4/18 with left lower lobe pneumonia with small parapneumonic effusion. Oxygen weaned to room air yesterday. A screening blood test for thyroid function was added on day 2 as part of a routine check. The result came back normal. No clinical action is required.
